Because we are a small boutique property with a close-knit team, our night staff plays a crucial role in maintaining high-end guest satisfaction, safety, and operational excellence while the city sleeps.We are looking for a reliable, responsible, and proactive Part-Time Night Receptionist who takes pride in absolute ownership of the property during the night.Position SummaryAs our Night Receptionist, you are the sole guardian of the hotel during the late-night and early-morning hours (typically from 00:00 to 08:00). You will manage late arrivals, early departures, safety checks, and basic food and beverage preparation for the morning. This role requires high autonomy, a sharp eye for detail, and an absolute commitment to maintaining our premium boutique standards.

Functie-eisen:
What We Are Looking For
• Experience: Previous experience in hotel night auditing, front desk operations, or security/hospitality service is highly preferred.
• Reliability & Accountability: You are someone who understands that a small team relies heavily on your precision. You do not cut corners and take your job tasks seriously.
• Language Skills: Fluent in English (both written and spoken). Knowledge of Dutch or another European language is a great bonus.
• Legal Status: You must hold a valid EU passport or an unrestricted Dutch work permit with a valid BSN. We do not provide visa sponsorship.What We Offer
• A competitive part-time salary scaled to your experience in accordance with the Horeca-CAO, including applicable night-shift allowances.
• A safe, beautiful, and premium working environment in Amsterdam.
• Independence and trust to manage the property autonomously.

Warehouse employee cable department 
 - € 2791 - 2911 - Alkmaar - 40 uur - Vast - Mbo 
Are you physically strong and good at working in a team? Then this position in the cable department is perfect for you! 
 Over het werk 
As an employee in the cable department, you do not need a gym membership anymore. It is a varied job that involves a lot of physical work. 
Your workday starts at 10:00 AM. Your team leaders, Dora and Zsuzsa, will have already prepared the schedule of what needs to be done. It is a versatile position, but don't worry you'll be trained step by step so you can learn all the ins and outs of the job. 
Your tasks include order picking materials, measuring and cutting cables using different machines, operating the combi truck or stacker, and keeping the floor and your workspace tidy. There's very little computer work involved, apart from entering information into the system. 
It's important to follow the safety rules and not work too hastily to avoid mistakes as much as possible. You will be working in a close-knit team that should feel like family. Everyone helps each other and works closely together. The main language spoken in this department is English, and people from different nationalities work here. 
 Wat wij bieden 
 - A friendly and enjoyable workplace - Plenty of room to develop yourself and grow along with the organization - A family-like feeling with your colleagues - Travel allowance starting from 10 kilometers one way - CAO Technische Groothandel 
 Wat wij vragen 
 - You are physically strong (lifting around 20 kg) - You follow safety regulations - You work well in a team - You are responsible and reliable - You are a good English speaker
